title: The Humble and the Afflicted ('Anawim)
lead: The Hebrew 'anawim and 'aniyyim, the humble and the afflicted: people low in power and wealth who depend on God. They run through the Psalms and the prophets, and Zephaniah gives them their clearest place as the remnant who survive the day of the LORD. The Beatitudes and Mary's song draw on the same tradition.
